aboutGame.title: What is Dragon Shelter?
paragraphs: Dragon Shelter is a cozy fantasy farming and life-sim game from Wild Forest Studio, published by Curve Games. You restore a forgotten farm, befriend and raise magical dragon companions, grow crops, cook enchanted meals, craft tools and habitats, explore fantasy biomes, and help a gloomy town come back to life.

Every dragon belongs to an elemental family with its own farm specialty: water drakes irrigate whole crop grids, fire wyrms fire kilns and smelt ore, earth dragons till hard soil and break boulders, and arcane glimmer scales purify blighted ground. Matching the right companion to each workstation turns a neglected homestead into a self-sustaining sanctuary.

modules.name: Dragon Shelter Beginner Guide
modules.description: A practical starter guide covering the first farm tasks, shelter construction, resource gathering, dragon taming, crafting, cooking, and early town requests.

highlights.detail: Plant fast crops like Sunleaf Wheat to fund your first tool and shelter upgrades
Tame a juvenile harvester dragon with matching forage before exploring dangerous zones
Build a workshop, storage chests, and a fire pit before nocturnal threats arrive
Complete town bulletin requests for coins, blueprints, and villager trust

highlights.label: S

highlights.label: A

highlights.label: B

modules.name: Dragon Shelter Farming Guide
modules.description: A farming-focused section covering soil preparation, crop rotation, seasonal planning, and how dragon abilities support everyday farm work.

highlights.detail: Till compacted earth and spread compost or elemental ash to raise soil fertility
Water morning and evening, or assign a Water Drake to irrigate surrounding grids
Rotate fast staples such as Sunleaf Wheat with high-value Star Bloom harvests
Replenish soil with a cover crop after two intensive planting cycles

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Dragon Shelter.

items.question: What is Dragon Shelter?
items.answer: Dragon Shelter is a cozy fantasy farming and life-sim game for PC and Steam, developed by Wild Forest Studio and published by Curve Games. You restore a forgotten farm, raise magical dragon companions, grow crops, cook enchanted meals, craft items, explore fantasy biomes, and help a gloomy town thrive again.

items.question: Where can I play Dragon Shelter?
items.answer: Dragon Shelter is available on PC via Steam, with the game released on September 24, 2026. Use the official Steam store link on this page to check the latest price and system requirements.

items.question: How do I tame dragons in Dragon Shelter?
items.answer: Scout the dragon's habitat during its active window, offer element-matched bait such as Ember Peppers for fire drakes, approach at a slow walk, tend any injuries with herbal salve, and escort the calm dragon back to an open nest.

items.question: What should I do first in Dragon Shelter?
items.answer: Start by clearing a small plot and planting fast crops like Sunleaf Wheat, gather timber, flint, and clean water, then tame a juvenile harvester dragon and build a workshop and storage before expanding your farm.

items.question: Does Dragon Shelter have Steam achievements?
items.answer: Yes, Dragon Shelter currently has 23 Steam achievements to unlock as you farm, cook, craft, explore the biomes, and restore the town.
